stem: The main action of formaldehyde is:
rationale: Formaldehyde primarily stabilizes proteins through crosslink formation.

distractor_rationales.B: Routine formaldehyde does not completely preserve lipids; many lipids are extracted during processing.
distractor_rationales.C: Calcium removal is performed by decalcifying agents rather than by formaldehyde fixation.
distractor_rationales.D: Paraffin infiltration occurs during tissue processing after fixation and clearing.

learning_objective: Identify protein crosslinking as the principal fixation mechanism of formaldehyde.
